name: small-api
description: Three-task change in a small Node module with a few knowledge notes; covers plan, develop, review and the retry/rotation scenarios.
goal: Make the cart module correct: total() sums item prices, prices are rounded to cents with half-up rounding, and format() renders a total as euros with two decimals. Keep the public API unchanged and add focused tests.

files.AGENTS.md:
# Agent notes

Use Node 24 built-ins only. Keep functions pure and exported by name.

docs/notes/pricing.md.title: Pricing rules
docs/notes/pricing.md.extra: Prices are rounded to cents with half-up rounding before summing.

docs/notes/format.md.title: Formatting
docs/notes/format.md.extra: Totals render as euros with two decimals.

decisions: Rounding lives in price.mjs and cart.mjs uses it, so total() and cents() cannot disagree.

tasks.title: Sum item prices in total()
criteria: total() returns the sum of item prices

tasks.title: Round prices to cents half-up
criteria: cents() rounds half-up to two decimals
